notes: Telling Crisp the contrast is wrong now works whichever way you say it. "The colours are contrasty", "the shadows seem contrasty" and "it feels contrasty" used to do the opposite of what you asked — adding contrast to a clip you had just said had too much — while "the video is contrasty" had always been right. Saying a clip looks flat now adds contrast from any phrasing too, and asking for a flat look on purpose still gives you one.
